purpose: Teach: 東方/長寿/祈願/武術/癒す/ユートピア/迷信/懐中

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、東方神起の曲覚えてたな
lines.en: Riku, you totally had that Tohoshinki song memorized, didn't you.
lines.style: Pouncing tease on his name, gleeful drawn-out accusation, grin fully audible.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で長寿食の研究したろ、桜
lines.en: And you did that whole project on longevity foods in home ec, Sakura.
lines.style: Instant deadpan counter, flat delivery hiding amusement, a small jab landing on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、試験前に神社で祈願したろ
lines.en: Riku, you went and prayed at the shrine before exams — admit it.
lines.style: Mock-scandalized rise in pitch, fast and delighted, barely holding back a laugh.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、武術部で道場稽古してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were the one doing dojo drills with the martial arts club, Sakura.
lines.style: Cool unbothered return, shrugging rhythm, a faint note of respect buried under the flatness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「音楽が癒す」って言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you're the one who said 'music heals,' you know.
lines.style: Softer than her usual teasing, quoting him slowly, a genuine note under the ribbing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でユートピア論調べてたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were deep into utopia theories for social studies, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick redirect, loose casual pace, mildly impressed despite himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「迷信深い祖母」のお話してたな
lines.en: Riku, you told that whole story about your superstitious grandma, didn't you.
lines.style: Wry needling with warmth underneath, savoring 'superstitious' with a playful stretch.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で懐中電灯ショーしたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah, well — you did an entire flashlight show at the culture festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Final trump card played slow, dry triumph, a tiny huff of a laugh on her name.
